## Biographical Information

(1826/7-1911)

second cousin of CMY

She married Henry John Tolcher in 1850. She was the sister of the Rev. [Charles Harward Archer](person_52.qmd). CMY's grandfather, the Rev. Duke Yonge, had a sister who married into the Archer family.
